StatDef.label: gravship fuel efficiency
StatDef.description:
How much of a gravship's fuel burn this person saves while aboard it.

Only the most efficient crew member aboard counts - this does not stack. Adds to the savings already provided by the ship's own components, capped at 90% total.

Has no effect without the Odyssey expansion.

StatDef.label: grav engine recharge
StatDef.description:
A multiplier on how long a gravship's engine needs to recharge after this person helps bring it down. Lower is faster.

Only the best crew member aboard counts - this does not stack. It is applied on top of the cooldown the launch ritual's quality already earned.

Has no effect without the Odyssey expansion.

StatDef.label: gravship range bonus
StatDef.description:
How many extra tiles a gravship can reach while this person is aboard it.

Only the best crew member aboard counts - this does not stack.

Has no effect without the Odyssey expansion.

StatDef.label: void evasion
StatDef.description:
How many effective levels of piloting skill this person adds to a spacefaring ship they are aboard, for the purpose of dodging incoming fire.

Only the best crew member aboard counts - this does not stack. Diminishing past the equivalent of level 20, and worth nothing at all past 22.

Has no effect without Save Our Ship 2.

StatDef.label: void gunnery
StatDef.description:
How many effective levels of gunnery skill this person adds to a spacefaring ship they are aboard, for the purpose of landing hits on an enemy vessel.

Only the best crew member aboard counts - this does not stack. Worth nothing past the equivalent of level 20.

Has no effect without Save Our Ship 2.
